{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Four decades of neoliberal capitalism have had a devastating impact.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Neoliberalism is a political project of lowering taxes for the rich and corporations.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Neoliberalism involves eviscerating democratic decision-making both in the workplace and at the ballot box.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Neoliberalism involves slashing spending on essential social services such as education and social security.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Neoliberalism involves deregulating industries across the economy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Neoliberalism involves opening up flows of capital across national borders.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The success of neoliberalism has enforced a culture of hyper-individualism and alienation from the kinds of collective, democratic organizations necessary to challenge the power of the capitalist class.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Transformational change in society does not come from moral righteousness or a checklist of policy positions, but from growing and wielding power.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"It is imperative to organize the largest possible number of people to join DSA and work together with broader coalitions united around common goals.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
